title: Cut AC by 1 hour a day
description: Turn off the air conditioner 1 hour earlier or use a timer and let a fan keep circulating cool air.

title: Raise AC temperature by 2°C
description: Setting your AC to 24°C–25°C instead of 22°C reduces compressor runtime by about 8% per degree without sacrificing comfort.

title: Switch bulbs to high-efficiency LED
description: Replace higher-wattage or older bulbs with modern 7W–9W LEDs and switch off unneeded outdoor or hallway lights.

title: Unplug standby devices at the wall
description: TVs, decoders, microwaves, and chargers keep drawing phantom power when idle. Switch off wall sockets overnight.

descriptionTemplate: Reducing {applianceName} runtime by 1 hour per day directly trims your daily kilowatt-hour consumption.
